collectedFacts.architecture-drg-role: DRG 保持为全局单例任务调度器（不是事件总线），插件启动时初始化。所有异步任务共享同一个 SchedulerLoop 和 DagEngine 实例，统一状态存储。
collectedFacts.harden-isolation: 每次 harden 调用创建独立 DAG（如 harden-<uuid>），任务 ID 带前缀隔离。harden 结束后整个 DAG 归档/销毁。
collectedFacts.adversarial-model: 异步通信总线模式：reviewer 和 executor 各持一个长生命周期 session，DRG 调度'思考回合任务'在已有 session 上追加消息。像聊天一样来回对话。
collectedFacts.task-granularity: DRG 任务粒度是'思考回合'：让 session 基于当前消息历史生成下一轮报告。任务输出包含 session ID 和报告内容。
collectedFacts.session-creation: 惰性创建，链式传递 session ID。reviewer_round_1 现场创建 reviewer session，executor_round_1 现场创建 executor session。后续任务从上游任务输出中读取 ID 复用。
collectedFacts.rounds-default-1-max-10: 默认1轮对抗（reviewer→executor→reviewer 为一轮），可配置最多10轮，串行执行。当前默认是 maxRounds=5，改为1。
collectedFacts.termination-condition: 流程结束当且仅当 reviewer 在一轮审查后认为没有需要继续追的问题（executor 的上报为空或 reviewer 全部认可），或达到 max rounds。终止判定权在 reviewer。
collectedFacts.rejection-3-times: 同一 finding 被 executor 连续拒绝3次后，reviewer session 自行维护计数器，达到3次后忽略该 finding，不再上报给 executor。
collectedFacts.report-format: reviewer 报告包含：问题、证据链、置信度（高/中/低）。executor 修复高置信度问题；对中低置信度自行决定是否修复；不需要修复的通过 DRG 报告回复 reviewer。
collectedFacts.integration-with-quality-gate: quality-gate 的对话负责决定是否启动 harden（风险评估）和最终收敛判定。harden 不直接修改 acceptance state 或 ImplementationRun 状态。
collectedFacts.current-harden-removal: 当前 harden 的同步 in-process reviewer→executor 循环（src/commands/harden.ts 中的 runAdversarialLoop）将被替换为 DRG 异步任务链。rebuttal 子循环被移除，由 reviewer↔executor 的多轮对抗替代。
collectedFacts.drg-engine-needs-extension: 现有 DRG 引擎（src/orchestrator/drg-engine.ts）需要扩展：支持运行时动态添加任务节点（用于表达 reviewer→executor→reviewer 的循环链）；支持任务间数据传递（session ID 链式传递）。
collectedFacts.current_state: DRG task scheduler infrastructure is complete; harden still uses old synchronous adversarial loop.
collectedFacts.source_intent: Redesign harden workflow to use DRG for decoupled async reviewer/executor task orchestration.
collectedFacts.core_motivation: Architecture decoupling: harden should run independently from quality-gate internals while quality-gate remains readiness owner.
collectedFacts.runtime_scope: Session-local only; no cross-session or cross-restart continuation required for the first version.
collectedFacts.drg_usage: Fully reuse SchedulerLoop; harden creates an isolated in-session SchedulerLoop instance.
collectedFacts.dag_growth: Runtime dynamic task injection is required.
collectedFacts.task_injection_owner: External callback injects downstream tasks; reviewer/executor executors do not hold SchedulerLoop references.
collectedFacts.callback_mechanism: Add lightweight SchedulerLoop onTaskComplete callback hook; do not change core DRG semantics.
collectedFacts.quality_gate_boundary: Do not modify quality-gate orchestration logic; keep handleHarden black-box markdown output contract.
collectedFacts.output_compatibility: harden output format must remain compatible with existing consumers.
collectedFacts.implementation_direction: Create harden-dag-manager.ts and harden-executors.ts; refactor harden.ts entry to delegate to manager.
collectedFacts.drg_instance_scope: Each harden run creates an independent in-session SchedulerLoop instance; no plugin-level global SchedulerLoop is required for this feature.
collectedFacts.drg_core_extension_policy: Supersedes old constraint 'do not modify DRG core'. The new policy allows generic DRG core extensions, but forbids harden-specific semantics inside DRG core.
collectedFacts.required_generic_drg_extensions: DRG core should support generic runtime task injection/data passing mechanisms needed by harden and future workflows, without hardcoding harden behavior.
collectedFacts.harden_dag_lifetime: Harden DAG is in-session and ephemeral; it is created at harden start and destroyed after final result formatting.
collectedFacts.harden_isolation_model: Isolation is provided by independent SchedulerLoop instance and harden-prefixed task IDs within that instance.

[high] Constraints: harden 输出格式必须与现有格式兼容

facts.session-creation: 惰性创建，链式传递 session ID。reviewer_round_1 现场创建 reviewer session，executor_round_1 现场创建 executor session。后续任务从上游任务输出中读取 ID 复用。
facts.rounds-default-1-max-10: 默认1轮对抗（reviewer→executor→reviewer 为一轮），可配置最多10轮，串行执行。当前默认是 maxRounds=5，改为1。
facts.termination-condition: 流程结束当且仅当 reviewer 在一轮审查后认为没有需要继续追的问题（executor 的上报为空或 reviewer 全部认可），或达到 max rounds。终止判定权在 reviewer。
facts.rejection-3-times: 同一 finding 被 executor 连续拒绝3次后，reviewer session 自行维护计数器，达到3次后忽略该 finding，不再上报给 executor。
facts.report-format: reviewer 报告包含：问题、证据链、置信度（高/中/低）。executor 修复高置信度问题；对中低置信度自行决定是否修复；不需要修复的通过 DRG 报告回复 reviewer。
facts.integration-with-quality-gate: quality-gate 的对话负责决定是否启动 harden（风险评估）和最终收敛判定。harden 不直接修改 acceptance state 或 ImplementationRun 状态。
facts.current-harden-removal: 当前 harden 的同步 in-process reviewer→executor 循环（src/commands/harden.ts 中的 runAdversarialLoop）将被替换为 DRG 异步任务链。rebuttal 子循环被移除，由 reviewer↔executor 的多轮对抗替代。
facts.drg-engine-needs-extension: 现有 DRG 引擎（src/orchestrator/drg-engine.ts）需要扩展：支持运行时动态添加任务节点（用于表达 reviewer→executor→reviewer 的循环链）；支持任务间数据传递（session ID 链式传递）。
facts.current_state: DRG task scheduler infrastructure is complete; harden still uses old synchronous adversarial loop.
facts.source_intent: Redesign harden workflow to use DRG for decoupled async reviewer/executor task orchestration.
facts.core_motivation: Architecture decoupling: harden should run independently from quality-gate internals while quality-gate remains readiness owner.
facts.runtime_scope: Session-local only; no cross-session or cross-restart continuation required for the first version.
facts.drg_usage: Fully reuse SchedulerLoop; harden creates an isolated in-session SchedulerLoop instance.
facts.dag_growth: Runtime dynamic task injection is required.
facts.task_injection_owner: External callback injects downstream tasks; reviewer/executor executors do not hold SchedulerLoop references.
facts.callback_mechanism: Add lightweight SchedulerLoop onTaskComplete callback hook; do not change core DRG semantics.
facts.quality_gate_boundary: Do not modify quality-gate orchestration logic; keep handleHarden black-box markdown output contract.
facts.output_compatibility: harden output format must remain compatible with existing consumers.
facts.implementation_direction: Create harden-dag-manager.ts and harden-executors.ts; refactor harden.ts entry to delegate to manager.
facts.drg_instance_scope: Each harden run creates an independent in-session SchedulerLoop instance; no plugin-level global SchedulerLoop is required for this feature.
facts.drg_core_extension_policy: Supersedes old constraint 'do not modify DRG core'. The new policy allows generic DRG core extensions, but forbids harden-specific semantics inside DRG core.
facts.required_generic_drg_extensions: DRG core should support generic runtime task injection/data passing mechanisms needed by harden and future workflows, without hardcoding harden behavior.
facts.harden_dag_lifetime: Harden DAG is in-session and ephemeral; it is created at harden start and destroyed after final result formatting.
facts.harden_isolation_model: Isolation is provided by independent SchedulerLoop instance and harden-prefixed task IDs within that instance.

assumptions: [high] Problem: 重新设计 harden 工作流，使用 DRG 做异步 AI 对话交互
[high] Decisions: DRG 角色: 全局单例任务调度器，插件启动时初始化，不改造成事件总线 (理由: 事件总线无法表达串行依赖约束，DRG 的 DAG 模型天然适合 reviewer→executor 串行执行)
[high] Decisions: harden 隔离: 每次 harden 调用创建独立 DAG（harden-<uuid>），结束后归档销毁 (理由: 独立 DAG 便于调试和归档，不同 harden 实例互不干扰)
[high] Decisions: 对抗模型: 异步通信总线，reviewer 和 executor 各持长 session，DRG 调度思考回合任务在已有 session 上追加消息 (理由: 长 session 保留完整对抗历史，提升推理一致性；像聊天一样追加消息更自然)
[high] Decisions: 任务粒度: 思考回合任务，让 reviewer/executor session 基于当前消息历史生成下一轮报告 (理由: 与现有 DRG 任务执行模型匹配)
[high] Decisions: Session 创建: 惰性创建，首个需要某类型 session 的 DRG 任务现场创建，session ID 链式传递 (理由: 避免预创建未使用的 session，链式传递是最简单的不依赖外部状态的方案)
[high] Decisions: 默认轮次: 1 轮对抗（reviewer→executor→reviewer），可配置最多 10 轮，串行执行 (理由: 多数 harden 只需一轮收敛，减少不必要的 token 消耗)
[high] Decisions: 终止条件: reviewer 判定无争议（executor 上报为空或全部认可），或达到 max rounds (理由: executor 不能单方面静默结束，避免跳过真正的问题)
[high] Decisions: 驳回规则: 同一 finding 被 executor 连续拒绝 3 次，reviewer session 自维护计数器，达到后不再上报 (理由: 防止无限循环，reviewer 自维护最简洁，不增加架构复杂度)
[high] Decisions: DAG 动态生长: 运行时动态创建，reviewer/executor 完成后根据输出决定是否注入下游任务 (理由: 不需要编排器，reviewer 和 executor 自行决定是否继续对抗)
[high] Constraints: DRG 引擎核心不因本功能修改
[high] Constraints: harden 输出格式必须与现有格式兼容
[high] Constraints: quality-gate 编排逻辑不修改
[high] Constraints: 同一时间最多一个 harden DAG 运行
[high] Non-Goals: 不改造 DRG 为事件总线
[high] Non-Goals: 不支持并行 harden
[high] Non-Goals: 不支持分布式多进程对抗
[high] Non-Goals: 不修改 reviewer/executor 的 prompt 策略
